metadata.title: Rego Policy Libraries — pqc (Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Readiness — v1.0)

controls.title: unrecognized profile %v — must be one of general, federal, nss (profile-gated checks were NOT evaluated)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: unrecognized profile %v — must be one of general, federal, nss (profile-gated checks were NOT evaluated)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: crypto_inventory must be an array of asset records (data-driven algorithm checks were NOT evaluated)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: crypto_inventory[%v] is malformed — asset, algorithm (single token), and a valid usage (key_establishment|signature|symmetric|hashing) are required

controls.title: Automated cryptographic inventory (systems, protocols, libraries, certificates) is not complete

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Automated cryptographic inventory (systems, protocols, libraries, certificates) is not complete

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Cryptographic inventory has not been refreshed within the last year

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: TLS endpoints do not support PQC key establishment (hybrid ML-KEM groups acceptable)

controls.title: Data with long confidentiality lifetimes has not been identified for harvest-now-decrypt-later risk prioritization

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Data with long confidentiality lifetimes has not been identified for harvest-now-decrypt-later risk prioritization

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Asset '%s' uses quantum-vulnerable algorithm '%s' for %s with no PQC migration planned (deprecated after 2030, disallowed after 2035)

controls.title: No prioritized, milestoned PQC migration plan exists

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No prioritized, milestoned PQC migration plan exists

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Key-establishment migration to ML-KEM (FIPS 203) for high-value/high-impact systems is not on track for 2030-12-31

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Digital-signature migration to ML-DSA/SLH-DSA (FIPS 204/205) for high-value/high-impact systems is not on track for 2031-12-31

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: FIPS PQC requirements are not flowed down to covered contractors and vendors

controls.title: Asset '%s' uses broken hash algorithm '%s', which is disallowed for all cryptographic use

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Asset '%s' uses broken hash algorithm '%s', which is disallowed for all cryptographic use

controls.title: Cryptographic algorithms cannot be replaced without application redesign

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Cryptographic algorithms cannot be replaced without application redesign

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No maintained inventory of cryptographic libraries and their PQC support status

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Vendor PQC roadmaps and FIPS 140-3 PQC validation status are not tracked

controls.title: Software/firmware signing does not use ML-DSA-87, LMS, or XMSS (SP 800-208)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Software/firmware signing does not use ML-DSA-87, LMS, or XMSS (SP 800-208)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: New NSS acquisitions do not require CNSA 2.0 algorithm support (mandatory from 2027-01-01)

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: VPN/router/network equipment is not on track for CNSA 2.0 exclusive use by 2030

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Symmetric/hash usage is not restricted to AES-256 and SHA-384/SHA-512
